study_strategy.look_here_first: Count leaflets and inspect the rachis before relying on fruit or fall color.

quick_key.if: many (roughly 13–21) narrow leaflets + clearly winged rachis + deciduous tall shrub/small tree
quick_key.then: Rhus copallinum var. lanceolata (source-pool Rhus lanceolata)

quick_key.if: 5–9 thick glossy entire leaflets + evergreen/semi-evergreen large shrub
exactly 3 aromatic usually lobed/coarsely toothed leaflets + low deciduous suckering shrub
